newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASG, Danzas take dispute to court.
newsitem.headline: ASG, Danzas take dispute to court.

text.p: Swedish-based transportation company ASG AB said on Tuesday that Swiss freight forwarder Danzas AG was demanding compensation of about 190 million crowns because of the end of cooperation between the two.
ASG said it was demanding about the same from the Swiss company and the two planned to settle the issue in court.
"ASG AB and its former cooperation partner Danzas AG have held negotiations since the end of 1995 about settling the broken cooperation," ASG said in a statement.
"These negotiations have not led to a result and a legal procedure has now begun."
ASG said the two companies began a 10-year cooperation agreement in 1992.
"At the end of 1995 ASG ended the cooperation agreement prematurely because, according to ASG, Danzas was not fulfilling its obligations according to the agreement," ASG said.
The cooperation continued within its air and sea freight operations and some European road traffic. This cooperation ended earlier this year.
